modules.name: Peal
modules.description: Change ringing sequencer: 4-12 bells, one bell per clock; Plain Hunt, Plain Bob, Little Bob, Grandsire, Stedman, Cambridge Surprise and a self-mutating Wander method; bob and single calls by hand, trigger or chance; open handstroke gap; a gate per bell, pitch, poly row and lead-end/rounds triggers

modules.name: Bell Foundry
modules.description: Twelve cast bells (modal synthesis) to ring from Peal: church, handbell or gamelan profile, metal, thickness, size, crack, clapper; true-harmonic, old or ombak tuning; heard from the ringing chamber, the churchyard or across town
